PRIVACY POLICY
Updated:
January 12, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect about the User, what we do with that information, and how we process it.

This Privacy Policy is for you if you are a User of our products and services.

The Privacy Policy applies to the JWIZARD Cleaner application, the website jwizard.com, and other interactions (e.g., technical support inquiries).

By using the JWIZARD Cleaner application and the official website jwizard.com, the User unconditionally agrees to this Policy and the terms and conditions of processing his/her personal information as stated herein; if he/she does not agree to these terms and conditions, the User shall refrain from using the JWIZARD Cleaner application (the "Product") and the website (the "Service").

For the purposes of the GDPR, we are the data controller.

THE PERSONAL DATA WE PROCESS

Personal information that the User provides about himself/herself when registering (creating an account) or while using the application, including the User's data. The User provides the information at its discretion. Personal information includes but is not limited to full name, email, and phone number.

Payment Information includes name, email address, hidden credit card number, license information, and, in certain circumstances, billing address and phone number.

Other Information means data that does not reveal the identity of the User, either by itself or in combination with any information we receive. For example, the User's device information, application usage data (activation, crashes, scans, errors), and IP address.

When the User accesses the Service with a mobile device, we may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device you use, your mobile device unique ID, the IP address of your mobile device, your mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browser you use, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data ("Usage Data").

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on our Service and hold certain information.

Cookies are files with small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier. Cookies are sent to your browser from a website and stored on your device. Tracking technologies also used are beacons, tags, and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze our Service.

You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service. You can learn more about how to manage cookies in the Browser Cookies Guide or on www.cookiecentral.com.

DATA UTILIZATION

We use and store User information as necessary to fulfill our agreement with the User and for our legitimate business interests in operating our website and Products, including:

To administer our Site and Products, authenticate Users for security purposes, provide personalized user features and access, process transactions, conduct research, develop new features, and improve the features, algorithms, and usability of our Site and Products;
As required by applicable law, legal process, or regulation;
To calculate aggregate statistics about the number of unique devices using our Sites and/or Products;
To send emails and other communications. We may send service, technical, and other administrative emails, messages, and other types of communications to Users;
For billing, account, and subscription management;
To investigate and help prevent security problems, fraud, and abuse;
To provide technical and customer support to the User. This may include remote access to the device to better resolve the issue. For this purpose, we will process information from the product and device (e.g., crash reports, usage data), the User's contact information, and other information the User provides us (e.g., problem description).
DISCLOSURE OF PRIVATE INFORMATION

We take measures to protect Users’ data. These measures include processes and procedures designed to reduce the risks of unauthorized access to or disclosure of data. However, we do not guarantee that the misuse of Users’ data by intruders will be eliminated. Keep your account passwords in a safe place and do not disclose them to third parties. If you become aware of unauthorized use of your password or any other breach of security, contact us immediately.

CHILDREN'S PRIVACY

Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 18 ("Children").

We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 18. If you are a parent or guardian, and you are aware that your Children has provided us with Personal Data, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected Personal Data from children without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers.

WHAT INFORMATION WE SHARE

We reserve the right, in our sole discretion, to modify or amend this Privacy Policy from time to time, in part or whole. We encourage you to stay informed of any changes to our Privacy Policy to be informed about how we use and protect your personal information.

These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.

ANALYTICS

We may use third-party Service Providers to monitor and analyze the use of our Service.

GOOGLE ANALYTICS

Google Analytics is provided by Google and tracks and reports website traffic. Google uses data collected to track and monitor the use of our Website. This data is shared with other Google services. Google may use the collected data to contextualize and personalize the ads of its own advertising network.

For more information on what type of information Google Analytics collects, please visit their Privacy Policy page: https://policies.google.com/privacy

LINKS TO OTHER SITES

Our Service may contain links to other sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third party link, you will be directed to that third party's site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit.

We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third party sites or services.

JWIZARD may disclose your Personal Data in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to:

To comply with a legal obligation

To protect and defend the rights or property of JWIZARD

To prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with the Service

To protect the personal safety of users of the Service or the public

To protect against legal liability

V. INTERNATIONAL DATA TRANSFERS

Your information, including Personal Data, may be transferred to - and maintained on - computers located outside your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ than those from your jurisdiction.

If you are located outside the United States and choose to provide information to us, please note that we transfer the data, including Personal Data, to the United States and process it there.

Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by your submission of such information represents your agreement to that transfer.

CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY

We reserve the right, in our sole discretion, to modify or amend this Privacy Policy from time to time, in part or whole. We encourage you to stay informed of any changes to our Privacy Policy to be informed about how we use and protect your personal information.

CONTACT INFORMATION

For general questions, please contact customer support - at support@jwizard.com
